name: sg_unsubscribe_groups_create
description: Create a new suppression (unsubscribe) group. Unsubscribe groups let recipients opt out of specific categories of email such as marketing or alerts. (POST /v3/asm/groups)

name.description: The name of the new suppression group. Each group name must be unique; max length 30 characters.

description.description: A brief description of the suppression group's purpose, shown to recipients on the unsubscribe preferences page. Max length 100 characters.

is_default.description: Indicates whether the unsubscribe group is the default group used when no group is specified on a send.
